input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Developer, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including resultado id, resultado, estado, loteria. The platform provides capabilities for http connection, ssl http connection, exceptions handler. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to create and manage resultado id records, so that I can track and organize resultado id data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage resultado records, so that I can track and organize resultado data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage estado records, so that I can track and organize estado data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage loteria records, so that I can track and organize loteria data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage municipio uf ganhadores records, so that I can track and organize municipio uf ganhadores data effectively.
